mercy.CommandConfirmation: The order of mercy echoes through the streets. Soldiers sheath their weapons, while fearful residents watch to see if your word holds. Final aftermath outcomes finalize upon departure.
mercy.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player ordered mercy for commoners, forbidding killing or looting, and commanded soldiers to keep discipline.
mercy.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player reaffirmed mercy and discipline; witnesses know this order remains active.

relief.CommandConfirmation: Soldiers tally materials you delivered and distribute them under the gaze of the townsfolk. Some remain wary, while others cautiously approach.
relief.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player ordered denars, grain, and goods delivered via AF Give distributed to commoners. Shared pool status: {shared_pool}.
relief.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player requested further distribution of unused shared relief. Shared pool status: {shared_pool}.

civilian_verbal_relief.CommandConfirmation: Promises of protection, resettlement, and order spread from this exchange into nearby alleys. Citizens do not relax immediately, but some linger to listen.
civilian_verbal_relief.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player did not distribute goods, but promised protection, discipline, and order face-to-face, reassuring defeated commoners.
civilian_verbal_relief.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player continued reassuring residents through direct dialogue; witnesses acknowledge protection pledges remain active.

inspiration.CommandConfirmation: Soldiers clear a square as sheltered citizens are cautiously guided forward. Your proclamation spreads through the alleys; the new order faces its first scrutiny.
inspiration.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player assembled commoners and proclaimed a restrained new order; residents and notables heard the pacification.
inspiration.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player maintained pacification; witnesses acknowledge public pledges to the new order.

rally_oath.CommandConfirmation: Representatives are ushered forward as the square falls quiet. Swearing allegiance is a public ceremony witnessed by all present.
rally_oath.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player organized a public pledge of allegiance; commoners, headmen, and notables witnessed the submission ceremony.
rally_oath.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player maintained the submission policy; local commoners and notables are recognized as having formally yielded.

plunder.CommandConfirmation: Pillaging squads deploy down the avenues. Soldiers confiscate wealth from merchants, notables, and citizens, logging seizures. Halting stops future looting without undoing past losses.
plunder.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player ordered targeted pillage; soldiers began questioning residents and recording seized wealth. Before escalating to slaughter, this order may be halted.
plunder.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player maintained pillage orders; witnesses know soldiers continue systematic looting.

massacre.CommandConfirmation: The order plunges the occupied settlement into violence. Soldiers pursue designated targets as survivors scatter or plead. Halting stops further pursuit, but deaths and penalties cannot be reversed.
massacre.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player escalated disposition to slaughter; soldiers began hunting targeted commoners and notables. Even if halted later, survivors remain terrified.
massacre.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player maintained slaughter orders; soldiers continue hunting targeted survivors.

cultural_repopulation.CommandConfirmation: Colonization ordered as top-level disposition toward {target_culture}. Soldiers hunt targeted residents; halting before completion settles partial slaughter; exiting submits colonization.
cultural_repopulation.FirstMemoryTemplate: The player ordered colonization through soldiers, demanding eradication of targeted natives to resettle as {target_culture}.
cultural_repopulation.RepeatMemoryTemplate: The player maintained orders to colonize as {target_culture}; soldiers hunt surviving targets.
cultural_repopulation.SceneTransitionTemplate: Colonization targets in {settlement} cleared; culture shifted to {target_culture}. Executed notables: {killed_notables}; new notables: {spawned_notables}. Devastation and penalties finalize on departure.

ReliefSoldierTargetValidation: [Siege Settlement]Ordering distribution of shared relief must be directed to your own soldiers in the settlement.
ReliefMissingSharedPoolValidation: [Siege Settlement]Before ordering soldiers to distribute relief, deliver denars, food, or goods using the AF Give feature.
ReliefRequiredSharedMaterialValidation: [Siege Settlement]Relief distribution requires shared supplies; if merely commanding not to harm or loot, choose Pardon.
CulturalRepopulationTargetValidation: [Siege Settlement]Colonization must be ordered through your own soldiers; civilians cannot trigger it.
DoneMenuFallbackText: In-scene settlement disposition complete. Continuing exits the siege encounter.
CompletedSummaryFallbackText: In-scene settlement disposition complete; exiting siege encounter.
MassacreVictoryMessage: [Siege Settlement]All targets locked for slaughter have perished. Final loot and penalties finalize upon departure.
MassacreVictoryQuickText: Slaughter targets cleared; finalizes on departure.
CompletedEncounterTemplate: [Siege Settlement]Final aftermath for {action} submitted; ending siege encounter.
LootSettlementSummaryTemplate: [Loot Tally]Final receipts: Market goods {market_item_total} / {market_stack_kinds} types, market vault {market_gold}, civilian denars {civilian_gold}.
SummaryCulturalRepopulationTemplate: Irreversible colonization submitted: settlement treated as devastated; culture shifted to {target_culture}.
SummaryMassacreText: Slaughter entered final settlement; casualties, survivors, and cumulative penalties follow the ledger.
SummaryPlunderText: Pillage entered final settlement; receipts and penalties calculated from ledger totals.
SummaryMercyText: Mercy and pacification entered final settlement; promises, relief, and reactions stored in town memory.
SummaryMarketItemsTemplate: Market goods: {market_item_total} items / {market_stack_kinds} types, valued at {market_item_value}.
